skippedTests.description: native macOS arm64 export and copied-app rejection controls
skippedTests.reason: MACOS_EXPORT_TEMPLATE is unset; native export requires the reviewed Godot arm64 Release template

topLevel: each arm is exported with its own options: the measurement project once, with the measurement files in the copy, and the product twice, without them
the manifest of each export is written beside its app, and the launcher's own readers read the four back
what the script refuses: unequal product sizes, a copy that is not the script's, a stale class cache, too little disk and a name that is not an export
an --out that already holds an earlier export is refused up front, before anything is provisioned or exported, and nothing in it is touched
a manifest that is not good is not written, the size of an app counts its files and no link, and the paths are relative to the arm's folder
the Release launcher in its rehearsal mode runs the exports headless, says so, and a campaign refuses it unless it is a rehearsal
each arm has its product's main scene, its set of files for the product and for the measurement project, and only C carries the extension
every pattern of a set says why it is there, and no pattern is repeated
an unknown arm is refused, by the description and by the function that shapes a copy, before anything is touched
the filters keep the measurement files out of the product, and the extension out of A and B
the real project.godot of civ-lite is the shape the edit expects
A and B lose the two sections of the extension and take their main scene, and the rest of the real project.godot is the same bytes
C keeps the project.godot it has, byte for byte, because its main scene already is main.tscn
the edit is idempotent, and it touches nothing but the sections it names
a project.godot without a main scene to write is refused, and so is one without the section
shaping a copy for A or B removes the addon, the artifacts of the extension and the sections, writes the scene and the measurement files, and says what it did
shaping a copy for C without the measurement changes nothing, and shaping it for B without the measurement writes no measurement file
the plan is the protocol's sequence in each lane in turn, limited to the slots asked for
the next step is the first slot without an accepted attempt: its redo before the next slot, no redo in a rehearsal
the analysis' stops stop it, a slot whose attempts are used up is the analysis' stop alone, and what the analysis cannot see stops it too
the unlimited lane is N/A from the first attempt whose vsync did not read back DISABLED, and its slots do not run
the executions of a campaign are the attempts that have one, in the order they ran, each with the number of its attempt; the others are the entries of its unreported
a resume checks the hashes of the protocol, the script, the binary and the package, what was registered, and the options
the wait for the load stops at the first reading under the limit, gives up when the time is spent, and the limit itself is quiet enough
the rehearsal's deviation names what that rehearsal shows: the Debug build only for the Debug launcher, the headless display only when its processes ran headless
